##Go-Live
Use these guidelines to record any issues experienced during Go-Live. 
- Create a new issue
- Use "Go-Live" Iteration Path
- Assign Priority

  - 1 = Critical, impacting all users or entire system
  - 2 = High, impacting core business process or entire business team
  - 3 = Medium, does not impact overall ability to conduct business 
  - 4 = Low, isolated occurrence or impacts single user only
- Assign to HSO Consultant or PM if unknown who can address issue. 
- HSO will create a bug if investigation indicates development problem.
- Use "Phase 2" Iteration Path if plan to address issue will be part of a Phase 2 effort.
